works.body:
Hello again! I would like to request another piece of artwork.
.Character is Azur lane's Helena again, with an embarrassed smile and a slight blush, posing like ST AR15 mod3 (https://imgur.com/a/JDWkMed)
.The guns are my Caliburn and SBL in place of AR's SPR and SBR (https://imgur.com/a/DeBdEDg).
.The background can be whatever you want.
Thank you for your considerations!

Hey, love your works and would like to commission artwork

I would prefer the resolution to be 4000x2250

Character:
- Ninomae Ina'nis
- https://hololive.hololivepro.com/en/talents/ninomae-inanis
- https://hololiveclip.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/Ninomae-Inanis-reference-sheet-provided-as-part-of-the-Pixiv.jpg
- Optionally wearing casual clothing

Weapon:
- M4A1 Block II SOPMOD
- https://photos.app.goo.gl/sAtJVNsZRkBqd2hV9

Pose:
- I'd like her to be holding the gun relaxed, barrel down
- Facing towards the viewer
- The rest is up to you

Background:
- Early morning
- Up to you, if possible, something similar to the below
- https://photos.app.goo.gl/eu9LTtU6RydTZrNR7
- https://photos.app.goo.gl/nExm8G5Gz1bNAiyK7

I would like to use the commission for:
- Wallpaper
- SNS
- Sharing with friends

Thanks again, looking forward to how it turns out ♡

Hello, I would like to commission an art work. 

The character is Helena from Azur Lane, wearing protective eyeglasses and she is playing in an indoor arena (https://imgur.com/a/ydsNpw6).

She is aiming an Orion Lynx and has a Jack Rabbit Bulwark on a 1-point sling (https://imgur.com/a/hAArQVq).

You can decide on any other details aside from those.

Thank you.

Hello! I really like your works with girls  holding guns, and I'd like to request some art of my character.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PEm7bUIakNywUUjLW2XbLWwAF2kdaFVd?usp=sharing

I'd like you to draw her in a casual pose, holding a rifle.

Could you please draw her in the military/tactical outfit included in the references. (In the 'Outfit SFW' folder)

The rifle I'd like her to hold is pictured here: https://www.artstation.com/artwork/48mgQ8

Any other details I will leave up to you. Thank you!

Hello! Please draw my original character named Elevoia wielding a VSS Vintorez rifle. She should be sitting side-saddle on a broom because she is a powerful witch. She can be aiming down the sight at an enemy that is off screen. She has a deadpan and expressionless face. Her little rat companion can be on her shoulder pointing towards the enemy, as if he's instructing her to fire.

I would also like the gun to have a slight indicator of magic, I'm thinking maybe some magical runes slightly glowing along the barrel. But otherwise I'd like it to look normal. If possible, it would also be cool if the barrel was smoking a little, indicating that she's already shot a few bullets, but not required.

Firearm: https://imgur.com/a/5yH8zcR
Elevoia: https://imgur.com/a/1VB7N9W

Thank you!

https://imgur.com/a/1VB7N9W

Hi! I love your work, I hope you will be happy to take my request.
Please may I request DeLacey from Project Neural Cloud.
I would love to see her in casual clothing, like her White Day costume - though it does not have to be same.
I would like her to be happy and smiling and to be pleased to see the viewer.
All other details I leave to you.
Thank you!

Reference: https://files.catbox.moe/3qn293.webm
Hello Martin. I'd like MCX from Girls' Frontline wearing M4A1's mod3 costume (https://iopwiki.com/wiki/M4A1#/media/File%3AM4A1_costume1.png) to celebrate her winning the NGSW contest

Hello Martin, so I'm sure you are aware of the MCX winning the NGSW with the United States Army so celebrate this, I would like SIG MCX from Girls' Frontline wearing M4A1's pre-mod3 clothes.
The only thing I'll ask is that M4's leotard is drawn like it was a sleeveless sweater like it was pre-anime days

Nice to meet you. I would like to make a request.

The character is THE great beauty, Futaba Riho.

She wears a blue bikini as in the original story.

The genre is giant girl.

The situation should be something like this.
Riho, who is gigantic, is kneeling close to the big Ferris wheel, pressing her stomach and waist area to destroy the Ferris wheel. The wreckage of the destroyed amusement park facility is scattered around.

Hello,

I like your drawings of girls with guns and would like to request one! Can you draw a woman in a Swiss military uniform (TAZ83 camouflage pattern) shouldering and aiming an Stgw 57 (SIG 510). I would like the woman to look confident and competent.

Thank you for your time!
-Eukie

(I hope I'm doing everything right, I've never used Skeb before.)

https://imgur.com/a/sIZoUcj

Hello.
I was very attracted to Martin's beautiful illustration, so I am sending you a request.
I would like to request an illustration of myself.
Please refer to the URL for the basic appearance.
https://twitter.com/reametaru0120/status/1400314059552002048

[About the illustration
The composition should be the pose shown in the document URL, with the face visible and the face in a darker, less visible pattern.
We would be very happy if you could draw it attractively in Martin's style.

Purpose of use
Use for general Vtuber activities (may be used for the following purposes)
Posting on social networking sites, introduction, reflection and use as thumbnails in Youtube live streaming, use in social networking sites and Youtube icons

Other
We would appreciate it if you could separate the background from the layers of the person in psd format.

That is all. We would appreciate it if you would consider our proposal.

https://tadaup.jp/loda/0414145038559783.jpg

Hello! Nice to meet you!

My character in FF14 is wearing a Dolls Frontline M200 outfit and holding an M200 rifle.
I would like to request a standing picture.

I will leave the poses and background to you.

Also, the character is very small in height, so we would be fine if you could make it as large as possible.
Thank you for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xWZI_BxvYOyOBg_c3p1ojDGqgp5qBofY?usp=sharing

Hello. I was wondering if you could draw my character with an AK-47. She is a wolf girl. Can you please draw visible abs and large breasts? The design is a very rough sketch so feel free to add your own spin on it and add details.

I will leave the background and pose up to you.

https://i.imgur.com/oy9v3wE.png

Good day,

I would love to see you draw my vtuber avatar. I love the way you draw lovely girls and guns!
I would like my avatar to be using a Howa Type 89 rifle (89式小銃).

Feel free to pick any angle/pose.
Please include a background of your choice!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12kvDtfKF7swWDr3AOuhxgIE2YBR7Czra?usp=sharing

Mr. Martin
Nice to meet you, my name is Kadekuru.
Thank you for all your wonderful illustrations related to dolphins.

I'd like to request an illustration of the maid VTuber Angelina (https://twitter.com/angelina_vtuber).

I would like to request an illustration of her standing with a Winchester M1866 in the maid's uniform shown in the reference material.
For the expression, I would like her to smile at me with a light tilt of her head and a wink.
The background should match the image of a British maid or be monochrome white.

Martin draws female characters beautifully and guns coolly, and I would like to see a maid with a strong military background in his illustrations.
Thank you very much for your consideration.

https://twitter.com/angelina_vtuber/status/1448853504399863811?s=20

Well here is a change of pace for you.
I would like an artwork of MP40 and Thompson. 
Doesn't have to be anything complicated. Just the two girls being friends

Please create a scene where a giant character sits on top of a building, only to have it collapse on top of him, causing him to fall on his back with a thud.
The link should be the setting of the original character Minhye, and the costume should be the basic one she wears.

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1I_b-NP_vpXxpHSenkjo8sonqrexs1WZS/view?usp=sharing

Hello Martin, hope you have been well. I wanted to request a giantess picture again. This time of SPAS-12 from Dolls Frontline. I wanted her sitting on a building (you can choose the building) and she would be cleaning her shotgun. She could be cleaning it with a giant rag, or even brushing it down with a tree. Feel free to choose whichever outfit for her. Thank you for considering.

My real life friend is a fan of your work, and would love to be depicted as a giantess, attacking and destroying Port Hercule, in Monaco, and destroying fancy rich people luxury yachts or sports cars there. Included in the folder is a sub-folder of reference images of cars, boats, and the port she wants to destroy in question! Please use whichever images of her you find most interesting!

Thank you!

USPちゃん（ドールズフロントライン）の巨大化した姿を描いていただけますか？

i.imgur.com/7Xsq5Lu.png

それ以外の制限はありません。お好きなように描いてください。

どうもありがとうございます！

Hello! I really like your art, I enjoy it a lot.

I would like to request a picture of Welrod and Sten please. They should be taking a selfie together, Sten is very genki but Welrod is nervous.

* Sten original costume or MOD3 costume, either is fine
* Welrod normal costume please
* Sten's arm is around Welrod's shoulder or waist, to pull her in closer (pose1 or pose2)
* Sten's expression is winking or てへぺろ
* Welrod's expression is like pose1 (embarrassed) or pose3 (doesn't want to take a photo)
* Welrod is doing peace-sign or double-peace-sign
* Sten should be holding the phone sideways
* Please use the new iphone 13 as a model if possible (笑)
* Any background behind them is fine. A dormitory, picnic, cafe, game centre, classroom, etc etc. I thought maybe day-and-night would look cool, but it's really weird and difficult

Feel free to change any details if you think it would look better. Thank you very much! 🙏

https://www.dropbox.com/sh/0izx1h5c8g1qf53/AABI5HZBZon_9C5sDV2x4_4Ta?dl=0
Can you draw STAR from Girls' Frontline wearing a cow bikini, eating steak and drinking strawberry milk?

Hey Martin its me again.

Just received shocking news that artist of STG-940 have just passed away. As a fan I really want to do something at this sad moment... like, commission a picture as my condolence to him.

So this time will be giantess STG-940, with background, anything to express feeling of memorial is all fine. I leave the rest on you, much thanks!

Hi Martin, it is me again, I hope you are well. If possible, I wanted to request a giantess drawing of AK-12 in her swimsuit. I just wanted her walking along a coastline or a beach, while she is carrying her surfboard and she has as smile on her face. You can draw her with her eyes open or closed if you want. Once again, if the request is accepted, I will post it on Twitter and give you full credit.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GGp7BCTr0btLPGNMOw2QcWNm-6Ok19gQ?usp=sharing

Hey Martin. It's me again~

I would like to throw another commission to you(with background this time), so I put a small raise on the amount. Hope you will accept it~

This time I'm featuring RPD(3 star T-Doll), since she was developed after WWII and used in cold-war era, I would like a commission contain those factor: RPD(giantess ofc), and cold-war background.

The detail of design is totally on you, and I would like her weapon to be drawn if I may.

It's always a pleasure to commission you!

彼女は馬に乗っています。ただ、彼女は滑稽なほど背が高すぎて、そのため重すぎて馬が動けないのです。

A few airplanes would fly past her face, and she would look at them with an angry expression, as she would consider it rude that they are flying past her face. Heyo, another special request for you! ^^
I want to see you draw more G3 art, so this time I have a historical request. I want to see Dolls Frontline G3 as part of the Portuguese Dragoons of Angola, an elite Cavalry troop during the Ultramar War which my uncle was a part of! I will provide lots of pictures to help you.  c:
As always, feel free to pick any angle or pose you want or most comfortable with, I'm looking forward to it.
Thank you!

Long time no see martin!

I depend all rest on you. Thanks~
